This is anadvanced workflowdesigned for those familiar with ComfyUI who wantpro graderesults. It is node heavy and has numerous options. I encourage you to take the time to learn it. This model does not adapt well to simple versions.

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/synth.studio.models/

Ver 2.0

  • Updated LoRA loaders to put them before CFG override

  • added one for Unconditional model

  • put the option of only using a single model

  • Quick math tweak.

Ver 1.0 (Beta)

  • VRAM friendly. Includes Kajai's Optimizer nodes for low VRAM

  • Modified the instruct to better do NSFW without the "safety filter" warning.

  • JSON prompt creator

    • Load an image 🖼️,or...

    • use the built in LLM,or...

  • Detailer Daemon

  • Fixed the creator's quality modifier math.

  • Hi res upscaler.

  • Seed VR2 (bake small, blow up big!)

  • 🎨 Post Production Suite
